name: Djed
description: Overcollateralized algorithmic stablecoin co-developed by IOG and operated by COTI, where DJED and the reserve coin SHEN are both backed by a single ADA reserve. Minting is throttled when the reserve ratio leaves its 400-800 percent band.
notes: Asset set is the protocol's own three tokens and is fully determined by the design (stablecoin, reserve coin, base coin) rather than by a listing. Mechanics corroborated across IOG and COTI sources. Circulating DJED supply is small relative to other Cardano stablecoins.
